description: This file defines the AssistantMessageParser class, which processes chunks of assistant message text, maintains parser state, and extracts structured content blocks including tool uses and text segments. It handles streaming input, partial parsing, and size limits.

classes.name: AssistantMessageParser
classes.description: Parser class for processing assistant messages in chunks, maintaining state, and extracting structured content blocks.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of AssistantMessageParser and resets its state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state, clearing content blocks and internal variables.

methods.name: getContentBlocks
methods.description: Returns a shallow copy of the current parsed content blocks.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a new chunk of text, updates parser state, and extracts content blocks.

methods.name: finalizeContentBlocks
methods.description: Marks all partial content blocks as complete after processing the last chunk.
